description: WP-G4 Codex: Orks (11e) FORTIFICATION (Big'ed Bossbunka): an enemy unit engaged with only FORTIFICATION units can be selected as a target of ranged attacks, and those attacks have -1 to hit (excluding [CLOSE-QUARTERS]). Fixture ork11e_g4_fort (tests/helpers/gen_codex11e_g4_fixtures.gd; P1 Orks' Shooting phase, P2 Custodian Guard engaged with only the Bossbunka). A real token click selects the Boyz; the shooting panel offers the engaged Custodian Guard as a target (normally an engaged non-MONSTER/VEHICLE unit cannot be targeted, 04.02); the shoota is assigned with the actions the panel sends; at the hit pause the dock's modifier breakdown names 'Fortification'. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players 0 CP; the Guard's wounds inflated.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_GUARD_A"].models:
	m["wounds"] = 99
	m["current_wounds"] = 99
return true

steps.script:
var dock = tree.current_scene.get_node("ShootingController").resolution_dock
var t := ""
for c in dock.modifier_box.find_children("*", "Label", true, false):
	t += str(c.text) + " | "
print("[g4] dock modifiers: ", t)
return t.find("Fortification") >= 0
